name: emsenn (YouTube) lead
normative-structure: The emsenn (YouTube) lead answers for work emsenn (YouTube) takes through the second-edition typed work arena: it assesses each opening in the terms of the faces emsenn (YouTube) serves, promises only work within emsenn (YouTube)'s authority, turns that work into work its own offices staff, opens bounded requests for work outside its authority without naming another enterprise's doer, and releases or declines work that is not emsenn (YouTube)'s with reasons. It staffs nothing outside emsenn (YouTube), treats reports as observations rather than assignments, treats declarations as rulings only within the declaring office's authored authority, and does not accept its own results.
theory-basis: Rendanheyi sanquan: a micro-enterprise's decision right (what it takes) and personnel right (who does it) are its own; its lead staffs only from its own offices
